t: This is Lambeth Road, which runs between Lambeth Bridge on the Thames at its western end and St George's Circus at its eastern end. It is the A3203, and the boundary between Lambeth and Southwark follows it for part of its length, from King Edward's Walk to Kennington Road. Thomas Lord, a British ornithologist recorded between 1791 and 1796, lived here. The material says little more about him, so I will not guess at his work.
